draft_subject: Public architectural research route for the Korean Architects Union
draft_body:
Dear UIA Secretariat,

Your member page names the Korean Architects Union in North Korea (https://www.uia-architectes.org/en/member/north-korea-korean-architects-union-kau/).

I am developing Proxy Society, an architectural research project on how civic-building thresholds accommodate people and AI/robot services acting for absent people. For the Korea research map, I am looking for published architectural scholarship or an appropriate professional introduction route, without assuming a local contact or doctoral opportunity.

Could UIA advise whether KAU has a public channel for such research enquiries, or suggest accessible publications and a suitable institutional intermediary? A referral or clarification of the available route would be helpful.

Best regards,
Kris Haamer
Proxy Society
https://proxysociety.org/architecture
